cd /workspace/task && cat > write_answer.py << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.worksheet.formula import ArrayFormula

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Summary']

# Array formula for student number (column B)
ws['B3'] = ArrayFormula('B3:B68', '=IFERROR(INDEX(Data!$B$2:$B$66,SMALL(IF(Data!$D$2:$D$66="Lowest Performing",ROW(Data!$D$2:$D$66)-ROW(Data!$D$2)+1),ROW()-2)),"")')
# Array formula for student name (column C)
ws['C3'] = ArrayFormula('C3:C68', '=IFERROR(INDEX(Data!$C$2:$C$66,SMALL(IF(Data!$D$2:$D$66="Lowest Performing",ROW(Data!$D$2:$D$66)-ROW(Data!$D$2)+1),ROW()-2)),"")')

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
EOF
python3 write_answer.py
